mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT jb.BALH_NM AS balhNm , gc.TR_NM AS trNm , gs.TR_YMD AS trYmd , gs.KRAK_YMD AS krakYmd , gs.BAEJ_GIJUN_YMD AS baejGijunYmd , gs.CHENG_YMD AS chengYmd , gs.SURY_YMD AS suryYmd FROM sjv9gs gs , szx0gc gc , sjx0jb jb WHERE gs.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND gs.balh_co LIKE #{balhCo} AND (gs.krak_ymd IS NULL OR gs.krak_ymd = NVL(#{krakYmd, jdbcType=DATE}, gs.krak_ymd)) AND (gs.cheng_ymd IS NULL OR gs.cheng_ymd = NVL(#{chengYmd, jdbcType=DATE}, gs.cheng_ymd)) AND gc.tr_cd = gs.tr_cd AND jb.balh_co = gs.balh_co ORDER BY jb.BALH_NM ASC, gs.TR_YMD DESC
